requiredArtifacts: Trigger, quota, duplicate-event and recovery plan
platformRules: Map the approved process to explicit functions, Google services and entry points; identify whether the script is bound, standalone or a web app.
Declare least-privilege OAuth scopes in the manifest plan and document the execution identity for every entry point. An installable trigger runs as its creator.
Distinguish simple from installable triggers and specify event validation, duplicate-event protection and trigger ownership; never claim a trigger has been installed.
Refer to current quota documentation rather than hardcoding limits; define bounded batches, concurrency protection, retry limits and terminal failure reporting as design requirements.
Preserve approval before consequential writes and test denied scopes, revoked authorization, quota exhaustion and duplicate events.
Produce a reviewable implementation brief only; do not run scripts, install triggers, grant scopes or deploy a web app.
